bio.text: Denise Powell, a Democrat, is a candidate for Nebraska's 2nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the May 12, 2026 Democratic primary.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as small business owner, corporate executive, and advocate for public education and healthcare.
Ballotpedia describes her as a former corporate communications director and partner at an architecture firm who co-founded the Women Who Run Nebraska political action committee.
